items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: I remember Mel Grant playing with Doc Evans.

ctx.x: Do you see any of the Chicago fellas there? There were... The piano players, Tut Soaker and Mel Grant around. Do you have to run into those while you were in Chicago? Yes, yes.
I saw them. Places like the Beehive and... I don't know, different places around. I remember, yeah, Tut Soaker and Mel Grant. I remember Mel Grant playing with Doc Evans.
And I never saw them at the Victory Club. No, they weren't generally. That was such a horrible piano, you can understand.
